qualifications: These table-bound equipment names/status/effect captions and junk descriptions are genuine nominal or telegraphic UI text. Do not add an actor, equip event, activation, count or effect where none is written. The explicit ability predicate at CC50 is retained, while its item subject remains implicit in caption format.
Written signed SP/ENMAX/HPMAX/AT/deployment-EN figures are preserved, including harmful plus costs. No conversion of SP+1 to faster movement or undocumented per-turn restoration is made.
Bombardment immunity retains battleship scope, beam versus solid-projectile distinction when written, and exclusive user eligibility. It is not broadened to immunity from all attacks.

Source-literal fullwidth codes/levels remain exact, including ＰＭＤ－, Ｊ, ＬＶ/Ｌｖ and written class codes. The one fullwidth compact SP/EN/AT effect-name row intentionally uses parent-approved ordinary ASCII stat abbreviations; this is not a global normalization.

PMD is never expanded. Written short components stay short, including J/Jojo/McTomin/Gania; no full name, rank, nickname substitute, gender or biography is imported. Native character identity records described by the author are not counted as my own additional100 full identity reads.

Parts versus wreckage, Class A/B, level spans, customized and rare-unit qualifiers, every-continent tradability and four value/scarcity descriptions are preserved distinctly. MF remains a written code where abbreviated; explicit Multiform prose is not Mobile Fighter.
Unused and None are distinct from three original empty comment objects. Native pointer presence is not proof of selector availability, acquisition or live use.
Current source/candidate flags remain all four pending. This independent accuracy report does not perform the parent editorial or final saved-English proofreading stage.
HM written EN-5/native -10 discrepancy retained; no mechanics correction. Complete item/quantity formatting is re-laid out without changing either original argument.
